extras: The plugin provides a demo vault and requires the BRAT plugin for installing beta versions.
intentEvidence: This plugin edits the link under your cursor through a small pop-up: Edit link alias changes just the display text, and Edit link (URL and alias) changes the target and the text together.
problem: Manually editing the display text or target URL of a link within a sentence is difficult and often impossible in Reading view.

relations.evidence: Alternative UI: popup for alias and target
Same link-editing goal; Alt-click preserves navigation
Narrower focus: any link's display text and target; no file renaming
Alternative UI: popup editing; no title formatting

summary: A tool that allows users to edit the display text or target URL of any link directly under the cursor in Obsidian.
